inputs.script: Clients hire on proof, not on software lists. Choose six to eight strong pieces. For each one, write a short case study: the problem, your approach, the output, and the result. If a piece was practice work, say so. Never claim a result you cannot support. Your portfolio should fit on one page, with your promise, your selected work, your services, proof, and an easy way to contact you. Keep a PDF version ready.
